    Subclasses of BuildingCard in it.polimi.gc06.mesos.model.cards.buildings
    Modifier and Type
    Class
    Description
    class 
    EndGameBuildingCard
    Represents a building card that awards additional prestige points at the end of the game, dynamically calculated based on a specific rule or condition related to the player's inventory.
    class 
    ModifierBuildingCard
    Represents a building card that modifies game rules or provides special ongoing abilities to the player who owns it, identified by a specific registry key.
    class 
    ObserverPairBuildingCard
    A building card that actively monitors a player's inventory and automatically triggers a reward whenever the player successfully completes a pair of inventors.
    class 
    ObserverSetBuildingCard
    A building card that actively monitors a player's inventory and automatically triggers a reward whenever the player successfully completes a full set of character types.
